name: Vikram (Chandrayaan-2) impact site
note: Imaged by LROC; the date is the NSSDC impact date, and the targeted area (70.8 S, 23.5 E) is not the crash point.

name: Shiv Shakti point (Chandrayaan-3 Vikram)
note: IAU named it Statio Shiv Shakti on 2024-03-19; NSSDC gives longitude to two decimals, and Wikipedia citing an ISRO brochure gives -69.373, 32.319.

name: Odysseus (IM-1)
note: Near Malapert A. The research note attributes these coordinates to Wikipedia (80 deg 08 min S, 1 deg 26 min E) and gives no separate NSSDC value; the lander tipped to about 30 degrees and lost power on 2024-02-29. Landing time is from Wikipedia.

name: Athena (IM-2)
note: NSSDC value; Wikipedia gives -84.7906, 29.1958. Press coverage says it tipped onto its side and lost power.

name: Shackleton crater (centre)
note: Feature centre from the USGS gazetteer, not a landing point; the page also lists -89.63, 132.32 and -89.90, 0.00 without labels.

name: Shackleton-de Gerlache connecting ridge (LROC point)
note: Point where the ridge meets the Shackleton rim, originally 196.739 E; a rim point, not the ridge centre or a landing site.

name: Malapert Massif (Mons Malapert)
note: USGS feature centre (name approved 2024-08-26), not a landing point.

name: Mons Mouton
note: Feature centre from Wikipedia (84 deg 36 min S, 31 deg 00 min E); the IM-2 touchdown is at -84.7906, 29.1957.

name: Nobile (crater)
note: Feature centre from Wikipedia (85 deg 17 min S, 53 deg 16 min E), not a rim or landing point.

name: Haworth (crater)
note: Feature centre from Wikipedia (86 deg 54 min S, 4 deg 00 min W), not a rim or landing point.

name: de Gerlache (crater)
note: Feature centre from Wikipedia (88 deg 30 min S, 87 deg 06 min W); the rim was not located.

name: Faustini (crater)
note: Feature centre from Wikipedia (87 deg 18 min S, 77 deg 00 min E); the rim was not located.

name: Cabeus (crater)
note: Feature centre from Wikipedia (84 deg 54 min S, 35 deg 30 min W), not a landing point.

name: Connecting Ridge (NASA Goddard study site 1)
note: Centre of the site's bounding box, originally 222.5 E; a study area, not a landing point.

name: Shackleton Rim (NASA Goddard study site 4)
note: Centre of the site's bounding box, originally 188.0 E; the research note says this centre lies on a steep crater wall.

name: Peak near Shackleton (NASA Goddard study site 7)
note: Centre of the site's bounding box; a study area, not a landing point.

name: Malapert Massif (NASA Goddard study site 23)
note: Centre of the site's bounding box, originally 359.8 E; the USGS Mons Malapert feature centre is at -85.98, -1.67.

name: Leibnitz Beta Plateau (NASA Goddard study site 20)
note: Centre of the site's bounding box; a study area, not a landing point.
